'''Rago''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], they were in charge in recovering the Republic's prison records containing the location of Imperial prisoners. They sent a fellow Imperial to retrieve the records from the databanks of the [[Detainee Processing Center]].<ref name="TOR" />
